description: This file is a Python script used to initialize or upgrade the database schema of the project using Alembic migrations. It defines an asynchronous main function that runs database migrations by importing and executing the run_migrations function from the project's database connection module. The script replaces older schema creation methods to prevent conflicts during schema upgrades.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous function that runs Alembic migrations to upgrade the database schema to the latest version.
